name: engram
description: LLM-native personal knowledge brain: markdown as source of truth, DB as retrieval engine

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @engram/server run test && pnpm --filter @engram/web run test && node scripts/run-js-tests.cjs
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm --filter @engram/server build && pnpm --filter @engram/web build && node desktop/scripts/prepare-desktop.js && node desktop/scripts/prepare-node-runtime.js && (pnpm -C desktop/server install --prod --node-linker=hoisted --ignore-workspace --no-frozen-lockfile || true) && pnpm --filter @engram/desktop dist
